title: mozgsml/memgres
description: Drop-in memory layer for AI agents on a single Postgres. Store documents (not LLM-guessed facts), edit by whole body or unified diff with content-hash optimistic concurrency, organize as an ltree tree, recall lexically or semantically (pgvector) or hybrid, git-blame every line, reconstruct any version, erase for real. Library + HTTP + MCP. MIT.

title: JetBrains/junie
description: An AI coding agent by JetBrains that ships code from your terminal, IDE, or CI/CD pipeline - powered by any LLM you choose

title: marcoakes/wringer
description: One command that proves whether a change is mergeable, and leaves behind evidence a human or an agent can inspect. Runs your repo's own gates; no LLM, no cloud, nothing uploaded. The verification core of a vendor-neutral AI-DLC harness.

title: naomytcheums-dotcom/job-agent
description: Job Agent is an AI assistant that tracks job postings, scores how well they match your resume, and drafts personalized cover letters. Import listings by URL or sync with France Travail and Adzuna, then manage every application on a kanban tracker. Built with FastAPI, React, and a pluggable LLM backend (OpenAI, Gemini, Groq). You approve every send.

title: alrcatraz/astra-aigate
description: A all-in-one system to organise your LLM providers, MCP, and other supportive services for your Agent or AI Chatbox in one place

title: open-multi-agent/open-multi-agent
description: TypeScript AI agent orchestration framework with dynamic workflows. Describe the goal, not the graph: a coordinator plans the task DAG at runtime and runs it on any LLM (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, or local models).

title: artokun/comfyui-mcp-panel
description: The local-first sidebar AI agent for ComfyUI — runs on your own Claude OR ChatGPT subscription (no API keys, no extra LLM costs). Drives your live graph: edits, workflows & installs in natural language. The panel UI for comfyui-mcp, the agent-native control plane for ComfyUI.

title: bgill55/daedalus
description: Daedalus is a standalone terminal-based AI coding assistant that runs on your machine. It connects to local LLM servers (LM Studio, Ollama, llama.cpp, vLLM) or remote providers (OpenAI, Groq, OpenRouter, Anthropic), routes requests intelligently, and gives your AI agent access to your file system, terminal, git, web search, and codebase indexing

title: danzevo/deep-research-agent
description: An autonomous AI research agent that orchestrates deep web scraping (Jina) and local LLM summarization (LM Studio) to generate highly accurate, comparative reports via CLI or Telegram.

title: Sdkwork-Cloud/hub-installer
description: Hub Installer is an AI-powered automated installer that uses LLM agents and MCP to download, configure, and run software projects or machine-learning models. It provides a unified way to install GitHub repos, HuggingFace models, and other AI resources with fully automated setup.

title: vailsen/paperless-brain
description: AI brain for your Paperless-ngx archive — chat with your documents via local (Ollama) or cloud  LLMs, with agentic tool use, semantic search, and long-term memory.

title: Mesh-LLM/mesh-llm
description: Distributed AI/LLM for the people. Share compute privately or publicly to power your agents and chat.

title: lorisunjunbin/petp
description: Python RPA toolkit with 80+ processors orchestrating browser automation, AI/LLM (10 providers), databases, SSH, email, and HTTP tasks. Configurable pipelines with cron scheduling and loops. Runs as wxPython GUI, headless service, or  Docker container. Built-in MCP Tool Server (Streamable-HTTP) for AI agent integration.

title: tjpoisal/UNIMATRIX
description: Unimatrix is a cloud-native AI memory system that gives any LLM instant, persistent context across devices and sessions. Built around the Model Context Protocol (MCP), it eliminates the need to re-explain context every time you switch tools or devices. Dual-layer mem, hybrid retrieval w/ recency decay, a Librarian agent, and enterprise encryption.

title: goruck/home-generative-agent
description: AI agent for Home Assistant — talk to your home, create automations in plain English, analyze cameras with face recognition, and get proactive anomaly alerts. Cloud LLMs or fully local via Ollama.

title: Particle-Academy/teachers-aid
description: Teachers Aid Chat (TAC) — an authoring agent that reads course material and proposes curriculum, course and test changes for review. LLM-library agnostic: one ChatDriver seam for Prism, the Laravel AI SDK, or your own.

title: Osmantic/ODS
description: Turn your PC, Mac, or Linux box into an AI server.  LLM inference, chat UI, voice, agents, workflows, RAG, and image generation.

title: maximoai-co/maximo-syntax-cli
description: Maximo Syntax CLI — The official command-line interface built for Maximo AI models. Optimized for high-fidelity code generation and agentic task orchestration. Also compatible with any LLM via OpenAI, Gemini, or Ollama endpoints.

title: ghost-in-the-droid/android-agent
description: Open-source framework to drive a real phone with AI agents: Android over ADB, iPhone over WebDriverAgent, 62 MCP tools, Python skills, a Vue dashboard, and swappable local or cloud LLMs

title: nguyener/Healthcare-Agent-Planning-Platform
description: Most AI chatbot projects demonstrate a single LLM response or a single tool invocation.
